title: Garage Door Safety Tips | Best Choice Garage Doors
lead: Photo eyes have been required on new openers in Canada since 1991. No sensors? Call us.
body:
Door went crooked?

Stop using it. It can damage parts or fall.

Door won't open?

Stop forcing it and check for a broken spring.

Check the balance

Disconnect the opener and lift. The door should stay put.

Motor runs, door doesn't move?

Likely a stripped gear. Call us.
